name: convert_tile_rows_to_bitplanes
description: Copies a block of tile rows between two buffers, then converts tile bytes through lookup tables into masked bitplane words and merges neighbouring rows with a masked exclusive-or. It runs in a loop until the row counter is exhausted.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: The recovered pseudo-code contains only an immediate return, so no behaviour can be confirmed from it. It is a stub or bad data and does nothing visible here.

name: copy_planes_and_swap_buffers
description: Copies four bitplanes from the source buffer into separate destination planes and fills blank areas with ones, then swaps the two screen buffer pointers. It sets a flag, waits for a busy bit in a shared control word to clear and then writes the start value.

name: swap_buffers_and_wait_busy
description: Swaps the two buffer pointers held in the state block and sets a flag. It then waits for a busy bit in a shared control word to clear before writing the start value.

name: copy_planes_back_to_buffer
description: Copies 1280 longwords from four separate plane buffers back into the interleaved destination image. It is the reverse of the plane split that precedes a buffer swap.

name: fill_checkerboard_mask_rows
description: Clears a block of ten longwords in the state block, stores a value looked up from a table, and fills a region of rows with alternating checkerboard words. The pattern rotates one bit per row, and each row is combined with the source bytes.

name: compute_clipped_viewport_bounds
description: Chooses one of two layout presets from a mode flag, then clamps the stored x and y position into the range allowed by that preset. It stores the clamped position and the window width and height.

name: update_object_list_offsets
description: Resets two list-head fields, then walks a linked list of object records in two passes. The first pass recalculates each record's scaled offset from its speed and a scale table and stores it back. The second pass repeats the walk to compute the offset without storing it, and it stops when a helper signals the end of the list.

name: turn_angle_toward_target
description: Turns a record's current angle toward a target angle by a speed-limited step, taking the shorter path and wrapping at a full 360-degree circle. It stores the target angle and the new angle back into the record.

name: advance_subpixel_position_by_table
description: Multiplies a signed table value by a scale factor for each axis, adds the integer part to the record's position and stores the masked remainder as a sub-pixel byte. It handles negative values by negating the remainder.

name: compute_angle_to_target_vector
description: Works out the angle from a record's position to a target point using an iterative shift-and-add approximation over a table of constants. It adjusts the result for the quadrant using sign flags and returns it.

name: compute_angle_to_target_vector
description: Same body as the neighbouring entry point, computing the angle from a record's position to a target point with an iterative shift-and-add approximation and quadrant correction. It is a second entry into the same routine.

name: compute_angle_to_target_vector
description: Same angle computation as the neighbouring entries: it works out the angle from a record's position to a target point with an iterative shift-and-add approximation and applies quadrant correction from the sign flags. It is a third entry into the same body.

name: render_masked_spans_to_planes
description: For each row, walks a list of horizontal spans and ORs table-driven mask bits into accumulators, then writes three bitplane words per column. The mask at each span boundary decides where each run starts and ends.

name: render_spans_to_four_planes
description: For each row, walks a list of spans, builds four plane accumulators from table masks, and writes each finished byte into four bitplanes. It merges with existing pixels through a colour lookup table.

name: build_scanline_edge_table
description: Builds a per-scanline edge table for a shape by stepping a fixed-point slope accumulator across the rows. Each edge crossing writes its column index and a computed value, and the loop is unrolled eight steps at a time.

name: allocate_slot_for_object_cached
description: Returns a cached index for the current object when it has not changed since the last call. Otherwise it allocates a free six-byte slot from a table, fills its fields from the object, and returns the scaled slot offset.

name: allocate_slot_for_object
description: Clears the cache flags and selects a slot for the current object, returning either its index or its scaled slot offset. It fills the chosen slot's fields from the object's data and writes the control word that starts the operation.

name: allocate_slot_or_pass_input
description: Runs the same object-slot allocation as its neighbours, but when a gate check fails it returns the caller's input value unchanged. Otherwise it allocates a slot from the table and fills its fields.

name: select_slot_if_mode_clear
description: Returns the caller's input unchanged while a mode word is nonzero. Otherwise it selects an object slot in the same way as the neighbouring allocators.

name: select_object_slot_unconditional
description: Computes the object's slot value from its flags and fields, then selects or allocates a slot in the same way as the neighbouring routines. It has no early gate checks.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: The body is a single immediate return with no work, so it is a stub that does nothing visible. It was recovered as an entry point but contains no behaviour to describe.

name: claim_slot_and_start_transfer
description: When an object has a nonzero value and no transfer is pending, scans the slot table from the top for a free entry. It starts a transfer into that entry by writing the control word and fills its address and pointer fields.

name: claim_slot_for_linked_object
description: Follows the object's link when the input is non-negative. If the linked value is nonzero and no transfer is pending, it claims a free table slot and starts a transfer as its neighbour does.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: The body is a single immediate return with no work, so it is a stub that does nothing visible. It was recovered as an entry point but contains no behaviour to describe.

name: reset_transfer_state_machine
description: Sets the transfer state word to zero, returning the transfer state machine to idle.

name: enqueue_transfer_record
description: Stores the next input item into a free entry of a table of up to 32 twelve-byte records and gives it the next sequence number. It also sets a count on the first record of a batch and stops when the input reaches its end.

name: run_transfer_state_machine
description: Advances a three-stage transfer state machine. It selects a pending record, waits a short number of ticks, and then clears a block of bitplane words with one plane set and the others cleared before releasing the record.

name: draw_text_string_to_planes
description: Renders a zero-terminated string into four bitplanes one character at a time, using an eight-row glyph table. Spaces are drawn as blank columns with the last plane set, and each glyph is combined with a colour mask from a lookup table. If the drawing flag is clear it blanks a 34-byte buffer instead.

name: format_digits_and_step_timer
description: Converts a number held in a fixed register into decimal digits by repeated subtraction of a table of powers of ten, writing a minus sign for negative entries. It then decrements a timer and, when it expires, reloads it and copies the next block of values into the table.

name: format_digits_and_check_marker
description: Performs the same decimal digit formatting and timer step as its neighbour. The only difference is that it tests a marker against a code address instead of a fixed data word before updating the timer.

name: draw_string_or_patch_labels
description: Draws a zero-terminated text string into four bitplanes, like its neighbour, using the string at a fixed code location. When a second mode is set it instead rewrites a block of label bytes and calls the glyph routine seven times with a stepped offset.

name: advance_countdown_and_scan_records
description: Subtracts a shift-scaled step from a countdown and clamps it at zero. When the countdown falls below a threshold it saves the current record pointer, switches to the base record, and scans its eight-entry list for a negative marker. That marker is flipped to positive, and the saved state is restored.

name: advance_countdown_scan_records_unguarded
description: Performs the same countdown step and record-list scan as its neighbour, without the early exit check on the mode word. It negates a negative marker in the record's eight-entry list and restores the saved list state.

name: scan_list_and_restore_state
description: Scans a record's eight-entry list for a negative marker and flips it to positive. It then steps through the current record list until a flag ends the loop, and restores the saved list state at the end.

name: flip_marker_and_restore_state
description: Negates the entry just before the current list pointer, then steps through the record list until it is finished. It restores the saved list state before returning.

name: restore_saved_list_state
description: Writes the four saved list-state words back into the state block. It is the restore step used at the end of a record-list scan.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: The decompiled body is only an immediate return, so it is a stub or bad data that does nothing visible. It was recovered as an entry point but contains no behaviour to describe.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: The decompiled body is only an immediate return, so it is a stub or bad data that does nothing visible. It was recovered as an entry point but contains no behaviour to describe.

name: build_eight_variant_sequence_tables
description: Copies 25 two-word entries from a staging table into a buffer, then builds eight variants of that buffer by selecting each source value or a transformed value depending on the variant index. It finally sets the playback pointer, step and counters for the sequence.

name: redraw_panel_and_format_readout
description: Copies 4000 words for each of four bitplanes from a source image into the screen, then updates the panel state. It formats numeric readouts as decimal digit characters, including hundreds, tens and units.

name: add_decimal_digits_to_text
description: Adds an eight-digit decimal table to the eight-character text at the pointer, carrying from the least significant digit and rewriting each character.

name: subtract_decimal_digits_from_text
description: Subtracts an eight-digit decimal table from the eight-character text in place, carrying a borrow into the next digit.

name: unpack_picture_to_four_planes
description: Expands packed picture bytes into four bitplanes row by row, handling odd-byte alignment and an optional inverted, scrambled mode. The strings it refers to are picture file names and report labels, so it unpacks graphic screens.

name: wait_for_fire_button_cycle
description: Polls the fire-button and second-button bits in the hardware input registers until the fire bit reads pressed with the second button set. It then waits for the fire bit to read clear before returning.

name: update_hit_flags_in_slice
description: Advances a frame counter and walks the object list in time slices, selecting records by a phase value. For each selected record it samples a bitmap at its computed screen position and sets or clears its hit flags, marking it finished when the sample is fully set.

name: select_record_and_fill_buffer
description: Marks the record as selected when it is the current one, copies its identifier and fills a 180-byte buffer with ones. It changes the selection state when a flag bit and a second field are set, and swaps the stored current identifier with a saved one when the mode word and identifier match.

name: insert_record_into_sorted_list
description: When a record is at the end of its list, saves the list state and finds the sorted position for its key. It marks the list entry as used, copies the record's fields into it and links it in before restoring the saved state.

name: search_list_for_matching_record
description: Searches the record list for the current selection key by stepping through records with their offset field. It clears the match flag when the list runs out and sets it once a match is found.

name: blit_object_across_four_planes
description: Works out a column offset from the object's animation field and a table, then programs a fixed block of hardware registers for each of four plane rows. It steps the source and destination by one plane's offset and starts each blit.

name: find_record_in_proximity_box
description: Returns the record's flags if it is already finished or selected. Otherwise it searches the record list for another record whose position lies within a 150-unit box around this one. When one is found it marks this record finished, clears its state fields and returns the result.

name: reselect_finished_record
description: When the record is marked finished, runs one step of the list scan in a specific mode. If that step is not flagged, it stores the record's first identifier as the current selection.

name: animate_marker_entries_in_planes
description: Runs a short countdown for the current selection, and while it is active it updates a table of up to eight three-byte marker entries. Each active marker sets or clears a bit in three bitplanes at its position, and the countdown ends by saving the selection and clearing its state.

name: spawn_pending_objects_from_lists
description: Takes up to eight pending entries from a queue and turns each into an object record, copying its position and type from the input. It sets the record's default size and flags, then processes a second queue with a different record type.

name: update_nearby_object_damage
description: Walks the object list and, for each record within 64 units of the current target, reduces its energy value and bumps its hit counters. Records whose values are depleted are marked as hit, and a timed sequence then decrements each record's counters and advances its state.

name: advance_object_state_timers
description: Walks the object list and advances each record's timer and state byte through a set of thresholds. When a timer passes its limit it sets the record's finished flag, and for the current selection it updates the stored selection state.

name: clear_matched_pending_ids
description: Compares the input identifier with two pending identifiers. When one matches, it clears both pending slots and, if the match is the current selection with no mode set, flags the selection. It also updates the stored selection when the other slot matches.

name: chain_five_helper_calls
description: Calls five helper routines in order and returns. It has no work of its own beyond the sequence of calls.

name: repeat_helper_until_zero
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and a second helper until the helper's result register is zero, then returns.

name: test_point_against_region_list
description: Walks a list of six-longword region entries selected by an index and checks whether the point in the two data registers lies inside a region's bounds. It also honours a time limit and per-entry flags, and returns the first match or an end marker.

name: advance_random_seed_mod_65521
description: Advances a 16-bit random seed by multiplying it by 125 and reducing the result modulo 65521.

name: build_bounds_entry_from_offsets
description: Builds a region entry in the next free slot from a source record. It accumulates offsets from a zero-terminated table to find the entry's position, copies its bounds, and fills the rest of the slot with end markers.

name: terminate_entry_list
description: Marks the entry at a fixed offset with the end marker and points the free-entry pointer just past it.

name: initialize_object_record_from_template
description: Fills a new object record from a template in the level's data table, copying its graphics references, type code, position and hit parameters. It sets default speed, timers and flags, and records flagged for special handling get adjusted type and state values.

name: update_object_record_from_template
description: Copies template fields into an existing object record and sets its defaults and flags, like the tail of its neighbour. It does not look up the table or the graphics references.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: The body is only an immediate return that passes back its input, so it is a stub that does nothing visible.

name: request_transfer_in_mode_two
description: Writes a transfer request block with mode two and a control value with its top bit set, then calls a helper to carry it out. A trailing check after the helper is decoder noise from an unimplemented instruction and is not treated as behaviour.

name: request_transfer_in_mode_five
description: Writes a transfer request block for mode five and calls a helper to process it, then returns. The result of that call is not used.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls a helper routine and returns. The flag test afterwards has no effect.

name: find_first_unflagged_list_entry
description: Issues a request block to a helper, then walks a list of values ended by a sentinel. It returns the first helper result whose low two bits are clear, or zero if none qualifies.

name: request_transfer_in_mode_five
description: Writes the same transfer request block for mode five as its neighbour, then calls a helper to process it. It was recovered from an unreached gap in the code.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: The body is only an immediate return from an unreached gap in the code, so it is a stub or bad data that does nothing visible.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: The body is only an immediate return that does nothing, so it is a stub with no visible behaviour.

name: store_position_into_record
description: Stores the two coordinate registers into fixed offsets of an object record, setting its position fields.

name: increment_table_byte_by_index
description: Adds one to the byte in the global table at the index held in the low word of the data register.

name: update_objects_and_check_proximity
description: Walks the object table from its start, skipping empty and inactive entries. For each record it updates its position or links, and for a record with a proximity flag it sets the finished flag when another object lies within 5000 units on both axes.

name: resume_object_walk_with_proximity
description: Performs the same object-table walk and proximity check as its neighbour, but resumes from the current table pointer rather than the start.

name: fire_weapons_at_targets
description: Clears a marker bit on every object, then walks up to 100 active entries. Each one that is not removed passes a random chance check scaled by difficulty, and when its target lies within 500 units with a remaining count, the count is decremented and the target is marked.

name: fire_weapons_at_targets
description: Continues the same target-selection loop as its neighbour from a count parameter. It removes invalid entries and marks targets in range, and it is a second entry into the same logic.

name: fire_weapons_at_targets
description: Another entry into the same target-selection loop, with the same range test and marking. The only difference is where it starts.

name: update_targeted_object_flags
description: When an object is marked as targeted, sets its active bit and sets a second status bit chosen by two other flag bits.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: The body is a single immediate return with no work, so it is a stub that does nothing visible.

name: add_value_to_free_slot
description: Stores the low word of the data register into the first empty entry, marked negative, of a 100-entry word table. If the table is full it does nothing.

name: update_object_state_and_target
description: Sets the object's display state byte from its flags. Depending on the flag bits, it either picks the candidate with the smallest value from a linked list or copies its current position fields into its track fields.

name: select_nearest_candidate_or_reset
description: Selects the candidate with the smallest value from a linked list and stores its index. It then copies the position fields and sets a status flag. If the list is empty it resets the position fields and sets the flag instead.

name: compute_scaled_squared_distance
description: Takes the absolute differences of two coordinate pairs, scales each by 1000 and returns the sum of their squares. The result is an approximate squared distance in thousands of units.

name: try_assign_threat_to_target
description: When an object is neither inactive nor disabled, it checks whether its timer has passed a threshold chosen by its type code. If so it looks for a candidate in the list, and on success it decrements a shared count, sets the object's timer and marks it active. Otherwise it marks the object idle.

name: try_assign_target_against_limit
description: Checks a candidate's value against the limit in the data register. When it is below the limit it decrements a shared count, sets the candidate's timer and marks it active. Otherwise it marks the object idle.

name: compare_value_to_constant
description: Compares the low word of the data register with the value 69 and returns either way, so the comparison has no effect.

name: pick_largest_weighted_field
description: Scans a fixed range of records and compares each one's weighted counter fields, keeping the largest. It stores the address of the winning field and calls two helpers when a winner is found.

name: pick_weighted_field_from_pointer
description: Performs the same weighted counter scan as its neighbour, but it continues from the current pointer and keeps its best value in registers. It stores the winning field's address when one is found.

name: search_list_for_best_match
description: Walks a candidate list, tracking the smallest value for entries with one code and otherwise testing each entry's flags and index range. It returns the first candidate whose result has none of the masked status bits, or the best value found.

name: search_list_for_best_match
description: Walks a candidate list with a different index-range test and the same tracking of the smallest value for one code. It returns the first candidate whose result has none of the masked status bits.

name: walk_record_list_until_record
description: Sets up a request block and walks the record list from its first record, comparing each entry's key against the value in the data register. It stops when it reaches the given record or finds a matching key.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: The body is a single immediate return with no work, so it is a stub that does nothing visible.

name: walk_list_until_key_match
description: Walks the record list from the top, subtracting a stored key from each record's field until the difference reaches zero or the given record is reached. It then returns.

name: queue_request_by_code
description: Stores a request in one of two fixed queues depending on a code value. Code 69 goes into a seven-entry queue, with the distance to the source computed and divided by 250 before it is stored. Other codes below 72 go into a seven-entry queue of three words.

name: relink_and_compact_record_table
description: Rebases each record's link to an absolute address, then removes records flagged as finished from the table. It shifts the remaining sixteen-longword rows to close the gaps.

name: relink_and_compact_record_table
description: Performs the same link rebasing and compaction pass as its neighbour, using a second record row layout.

name: relink_and_compact_record_table
description: Performs the same link rebasing and compaction pass again, reading the links from a different row offset before compacting the table.

name: clamp_point_to_grid_cell
description: Finds the nearest point of an adjacent grid cell, on a 6000-unit grid, to a given position. It checks the neighbour's bounds in the cell table, clamps the coordinates to the shared edge and returns the cell's scaled coordinates.

name: grid_cell_to_world_corner
description: Converts a grid cell index pair to world coordinates by scaling each index by 6000 units. It returns the far edge of the first axis and the near edge of the second.

name: find_nearest_rectangle_to_point
description: Walks a table of rectangles and computes the squared distance from a point to each one, which is zero inside. It keeps the closest rectangle and its position, and returns the point when it lies inside one.

name: find_nearest_rectangle_stepped
description: Performs the same nearest-rectangle search as its neighbour on a different table layout. It steps down a count and returns early when the point is inside a rectangle.

name: find_nearest_rectangle_x_first
description: Performs the nearest-rectangle search, testing the horizontal bounds first before the vertical ones. It keeps the closest rectangle and returns early when the point is inside one.

name: map_type_index_to_code
description: Returns a fixed code for three special type values. Otherwise it looks up a code in a word table, indexed by the type and a row derived from the data register, after remapping one special row index.

name: lookup_word_at_table_offset
description: Returns the word stored in the global table at the byte offset given by the low word of the data register. It was recovered from an unreached gap in the code.

name: tick_timer_with_link_swap
description: When an object's timer has come due, swaps its link field with another value and runs helper checks, possibly decrementing a shared count. It then resets the timer to the current time and subtracts a fixed step of 200, clamping at zero.

name: select_sequence_for_current_type
description: Picks an entry from one of several tables depending on the current type code and the timer, sets a status flag accordingly and returns a sequence value. If the timer has not elapsed it returns the timer unchanged.

name: test_point_in_rectangle
description: Tests whether the point in the two data registers lies inside the rectangle at the pointer. Both branches return without storing the result, so the test has no visible effect.

name: set_flag_and_queue_entry
description: Sets a status flag. When the mode word is negative it queues the table entry for the current type, then clears the mode word.

name: clear_flag_and_queue_entry
description: Clears the status flag. When the mode word is negative it queues the table entry for the current type, then clears the mode word.

name: queue_entry_for_type
description: When the mode word is negative, queues the table entry for the current type from the input pointer and clears the mode word. It does nothing otherwise.

name: run_action_when_mode_negative
description: When the mode word is negative, sets a pending flag, calls two helpers and clears the mode word. It does nothing otherwise.

name: store_scaled_byte_for_type
description: Stores a byte from a per-type table, doubled, into the shared value word for the current type.

name: store_table_byte_times_factor
description: Stores a byte from a per-type table, multiplied by a fixed factor, into the shared value word for the current type.

name: compute_weighted_score_and_level
description: Sums table weights over a list of objects to produce a weighted score. It derives a percentage bucket from the ratio of the sums and stores a value from a table for higher types. It then computes a level index, records it and returns a counter that increases when a level is set.

name: compute_weighted_score_alt
description: Performs the same weighted score and level calculation as its neighbour, storing the chosen index in a different global word.

name: compute_index_from_divided_value
description: Divides the data register value by a byte from the record, clamps the result at 12, and stores it unless it is the no-value marker. It returns a counter that increases each time an index is stored.

name: request_transfer_in_mode_one
description: Writes a transfer request block for mode one with a high control value, then calls a helper and returns.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls a helper routine and returns. The flag test afterwards has no effect.

name: increment_category_counter_for_record
description: Increments one of the record's per-category counters. The category is the position of the lowest set bit in a flag field, with a default slot for a special record type, and the counter table is chosen by a flag and a list match.

name: increment_category_counter_in_table
description: Increments the per-category counter in the table at the pointer, choosing the category from the lowest set bit of a flag field. It uses the same special-type default as its neighbour.

name: run_music_interrupt_session
description: Sets the task priority, initialises the music player, installs the timer interrupt and waits for the fire button. It then restores the interrupt state and ends the music player.

name: wait_until_fire_button_clear
description: Polls the fire-button and second-button bits in the input registers and returns as soon as the fire-button bit reads clear or the second-button bit reads clear.

name: install_cia_timer_interrupt
description: Programs the CIA-B timer and interrupt control registers with fixed values, stores a previous register value, and points the handler at the new interrupt routine.

name: restore_interrupts_and_dma
description: Writes the interrupt control register, restores the saved register value, and clears the enable bits for the low four DMA channels.

name: raise_current_task_priority
description: Finds the current task through the system library and sets its priority.

name: service_interrupt_and_call_music
description: Writes the interrupt request register and calls the music routine mt_music. The decompiled body was unavailable, so the exact order of these steps is not confirmed.

name: spin_in_empty_loop
description: The decompiled body is only an empty infinite loop, so it stalls with nothing else to do. Its listing touches the vertical beam position register, but the recovered code does not read it.

name: run_effects_and_advance_position
description: Runs the effect update for each of the four voices, then advances the song position with wrap at 128. When the end marker is reached it reloads the restart position.

name: play_voice_note_and_effects
description: Reads the next note event for one voice from the pattern data. It loads the sample's start, length and loop, sets the period and volume, and applies the effect command: volume set, pattern jump, pattern break, speed change or filter toggle.

name: continue_voice_note_after_loop
description: Sets the voice's sample position after a loop, then processes the note and effect command in the same way as the playback routine. It writes to the shared DMA control value only through the stop and port helpers.

name: stop_voice_and_apply_effect
description: Applies the effect command of a stopped voice. For the filter command it sets or clears the channel bit in the shared DMA control value, and it handles the pattern jump, pattern break, speed and volume commands.

name: set_portamento_target_and_effect
description: Sets the portamento target period and direction flag for a voice from its note period, then applies the same effect command handling as the playback routine.

name: clear_portamento_target
description: Clears the voice's portamento target word to zero.

name: slide_voice_period_toward_target
description: Applies one step of the portamento slide for a voice. It adds or subtracts the stored speed from the period depending on the direction flag, clamps at the target and clears the target once it is reached. The new period is written to the voice's period field.

name: apply_portamento_slide_step
description: Performs one portamento slide step for a voice. It adds or subtracts the stored speed depending on direction, clamps at the target and writes the period. It is the shared tail of the slide routine.

name: subtract_step_from_period
description: Subtracts the step in the data register from the voice period and clamps it at the target, clearing the target once it is reached. It then writes the period.

name: apply_vibrato_offset_to_period
description: Applies a vibrato step to a voice. It updates the depth from the effect parameter when one is given, scales a sine-table value by the depth to get an offset, adds that offset to the period and advances the vibrato position by its speed.

name: apply_vibrato_step
description: Performs the same vibrato step as its neighbour, without first updating the depth from the effect parameter.

name: set_period_offset_and_vibrato
description: Writes the difference between two values to the voice period, then advances the vibrato position by its speed.

name: apply_arpeggio_period_offset
description: Applies an arpeggio step. It selects a note offset from the effect nibbles based on the current speed index, then sets the period to the first table period at or above the current one, moved up by that offset. Otherwise the period is left unchanged.

name: apply_arpeggio_from_low_nibble
description: Applies an arpeggio step using the low nibble of the effect parameter as the note offset. It sets the period to the table note at or above the current period, and leaves the period unchanged if none is found.

name: set_period_from_arpeggio_table
description: Sets the voice period to the entry found at an offset into the arpeggio period table, given by the data register.

name: restore_base_period
description: Writes the voice's base period back to its period output, with no change to the value.

name: dispatch_voice_effect_by_command
description: Dispatches the effect command for one voice by its type nibble: arpeggio, portamento up or down, tone portamento, vibrato, or the combined slide and vibrato commands. It writes the resulting period to the voice output and falls back to the base period when no effect applies.

name: portamento_up_step
description: Raises the pitch by subtracting the effect speed from the voice period, clamping at the highest allowed period, and writes the result to the output.

name: portamento_down_step
description: Lowers the pitch by adding the effect speed to the voice period, clamping at the lowest allowed period, and writes the result to the output.

name: vibrato_with_volume_slide
description: Applies a vibrato step and then a volume slide. The upper nibble of the parameter raises the volume up to 64, and otherwise the lower nibble lowers it, never below zero.

name: tone_portamento_with_volume_slide
description: Applies a tone portamento step and then a volume slide. The upper nibble of the parameter raises the volume up to 64, and otherwise the lower nibble lowers it, never below zero.

name: slide_volume_down
description: Lowers the voice volume by the low nibble of the effect parameter, not below zero, and writes the result to the volume output.

name: apply_secondary_effect_command
description: Applies the secondary effect command for a voice: a filter toggle on the shared DMA control value, a pattern break, a pattern jump, a speed change, or a set volume capped at 64.

name: set_filter_bit
description: Sets or clears one bit of a shared port register from the low bit of the effect parameter. The same register holds fire-button and disk status bits, so the write touches those bits too.

name: break_to_next_pattern
description: Sets the song position counter to 1, which ends the current pattern early.

name: jump_to_song_position
description: Jumps playback to the song position given by the effect parameter. The position is stored one below the target so the next step lands on it.

name: set_voice_volume
description: Sets the voice volume from the effect parameter, capped at 64, and writes it to the volume output.

name: set_playback_speed
description: Sets the playback speed from the effect parameter, limited to a range of one to 31.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The recovered pseudo-code is only bad-instruction stops, so this address holds data rather than code. No behaviour can be confirmed from it.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data

name: run_main_loop_after_setup
description: Program entry point. It stores two startup values, calls a sequence of setup routines and writes a control word, then loops forever calling two helpers.

name: open_read_and_close_file
description: Opens a file through the DOS library and reads from it when the open succeeds. It then closes the file and the library, and returns the value read, or an error marker when the open fails.

name: write_file_through_dos_library
description: Opens a file through the DOS library and writes to it, closing the file and the library afterwards. If the write fails it takes a cleanup path that closes both and returns an error marker. It was recovered from an unreached gap in the code.

name: open_dos_library
description: Opens the DOS library by name through the system library call and stores its base address for later calls.

name: close_file_and_report_error
description: Fetches the DOS error code, closes the file and the library, and returns an error marker. It was recovered from an unreached gap in the code.

name: install_copper_and_mask_vblank
description: Forbids task switching and opens the graphics library. It saves the library's copper list pointer, points it at the program's own copper list, enables a set of DMA channels and disables the vertical-blank interrupt, then closes the library.

name: dispatch_pending_interrupt_bits
description: Checks the interrupt request bits. When audio channel zero's bit is pending it sets a state value and acknowledges that bit. When the vertical-blank bit is pending it restores the saved copper list pointer, calls a helper and increments a counter.

name: handle_vblank_interrupt_bit
description: When the vertical-blank bit is set in the input, restores the saved copper list pointer, calls a helper and increments a counter.

name: fill_table_words_and_pause
description: Fills eight entries of a four-word table with two fixed words, then waits through a nested countdown loop. It sets two more table words when a flag is nonzero.

name: wait_vblank_then_enable_interrupt
description: Waits until the vertical-blank interrupt request bit is set, then re-enables that interrupt through the interrupt enable register.

name: split_bitplane_addresses_into_words
description: Splits a 32-bit buffer address into high and low words, and stores the pointer pairs for four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, ready for the display hardware to read.

name: call_exec_permit_and_return
description: Calls the exec permit routine to re-enable task switching, then returns.

name: call_exec_permit_and_return
description: Calls the exec permit routine to re-enable task switching, then returns.

name: forbid_task_switching
description: Calls the exec forbid routine to stop task switching, then returns. The text the routine refers to names the program and title files.

name: run_routine_from_jump_table
description: Gets a selector value from a library call. If it is zero, it forbids task switching and loops forever. Otherwise it closes the library, calls the routine in a jump table chosen by that value, and closes the library again.

name: restore_copper_and_write_output
description: Restores the saved copper list pointer through the graphics library, then writes a short text to the DOS output stream.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The recovered pseudo-code is only a bad-instruction stop, so this address holds data rather than code. No behaviour can be confirmed from it.

name: write_eight_digit_characters
description: Converts a 32-bit value into eight characters by mapping each four-bit nibble through a lookup table. It writes the characters to consecutive bytes, starting from the most significant nibble.

name: copy_image_planes_to_buffer
description: Copies 4000 words for each of four bitplanes from the stored image into the display buffer. The copy is bracketed by two helper calls that set up the screen state.

name: copy_image_planes_to_buffer
description: Performs the same plane copy as its neighbour without the leading helper call.

name: allocate_display_buffers
description: Allocates a block of memory through the exec library and stores its base address. It also stores three offsets for the other display buffers within that block.

name: free_allocated_memory_block
description: Calls the exec free-memory routine through the system library and stores the value it returns in the buffer variable.

name: load_strikeiv_program_file
description: Runs two helper routines around a call into the DOS library, then closes the library. The text it references is the file name of the strikeiv program.

name: unpack_lzss_stream
description: Decompresses an LZSS-style stream into a buffer. It fills a 4096-byte ring window with spaces, then reads flag bytes whose bits select either a literal byte or a back-reference copying three to eighteen bytes from the window.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:0000
name: initialise_game_variables_at_start
description: Program entry point. It sets default values in a large block of game state variables and calls setup routines, including one that clears a byte table.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:06A4
name: reset_state_and_wait_frame
description: Resets the same block of game state variables as the start routine, then ends a frame by swapping the screen buffers and waiting for the frame counter to reach its length. The second helper it calls is a generated stub with no behaviour.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:08C6
name: reset_game_state_and_hardware
description: Clears a block of state variables and runs the interrupt setup. It installs a new copper list, zeroes the four audio volume registers and resets the pending flags, then plays a pending cutscene when one is queued.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:0C48
name: wait_for_key_then_reset
description: Waits in a loop for one particular input code, and when it arrives it resets the game state and hardware in the same way as the reset routine. A negative mode value makes the routine loop forever.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:0C96
name: initialise_screen_sprites_and_palettes
description: Prepares a screen by drawing text with the 8x8 font, clearing and linking the sprite table, and copying sprite descriptors and palette blocks into video memory. It may play a pending cutscene and reads the vertical beam position register.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:182E
name: transform_pointer_list_entries
description: Walks a fixed list of object pointers and, for each non-null entry, derives two scaled coordinates from its position fields and passes the entry to the object transform helper. Afterwards it handles a pending flag by setting a state value and a mode byte.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:18F0
name: update_linked_entries_by_flags
description: Walks a fixed list of pointers, then a linked list of entries, calling helpers on entries not yet marked. It registers entries whose flagged sub-record matches into a slot table and returns the last value read.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A8E
name: run_animation_flag_update
description: Calls the animation flag update routine on the record. The decompiled body timed out, so its own logic is not confirmed and only this call is known.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:31F4
name: match_trigger_entry_for_key
description: Searches a table of nine-short entries for one whose key matches the first parameter, then tests each entry's two condition slots against the second value. A slot of one kind compares against two ranges and a slot of the other kind needs an exact match. It returns 1 on a match and zero otherwise.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3272
name: match_trigger_entries_in_sequence
description: Steps through consecutive nine-short entries, testing each entry's conditions against the value in the data registers. It returns 1 at the first match or zero when the list ends, and is the register-based form of its neighbour's condition test.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:32AE
name: match_trigger_entries_second_slot
description: Performs the same entry-by-entry condition test as its neighbour, with the condition slots read in a different order. It returns 1 at the first match and zero when the list ends.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:32C2
name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value one with no other work. It is a constant-result stub that always reports success.
